name: Volumetric Super-Resolution with Auxiliary Features and Temporal Warping
aliases: Deep Learning Based Super-Resolution for Medical Volume Visualization
definition: A deep learning pipeline for super-resolving volume-rendered images that supplements the network with auxiliary volumetric features (depth, color, opacity at max alpha) and uses temporal warping with a reweighting network to handle motion and lighting changes.
summary: This deep learning method super-resolves volume-rendered images by using auxiliary volumetric features and temporal warping to resolve depth ambiguity and handle motion, differing from standard image super-resolution.
